description: Abbott Laboratories is an Illinois corporation incorporated in 1900 whose principal business is the discovery, development, manufacture and sale of a broad and diversified line of healthcare products. It operates through four reportable segments: Established Pharmaceutical Products, Diagnostic Products, Nutritional Products, and Medical Devices. Established Pharmaceutical Products comprise branded generic pharmaceuticals manufactured worldwide and marketed outside the United States in emerging markets, with portfolios in gastroenterology (Creon, Duphalac, Duspatal), women's health (Duphaston, Femoston), cardiovascular and metabolic therapies (Lipanthyl, TriCor, Synthroid), and pain and central nervous system medicines. In November 2025 Abbott entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Exact Sciences Corporation, which is expected to enable it to enter the cancer diagnostics market.
